body.heading: Where in the world is Latvia?
paragraphs: Latvia is a country in Northern Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Latvia is Riga.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Latvia is Latvian.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Latvia is the euro. The euro is shared by many countries in Europe, so the same coins and notes work across borders.

body.heading: How big is Latvia?
paragraphs: Latvia covers about 65,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Greece.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Riga has more art nouveau buildings than almost any city — whole streets of carved faces and swirls — plus a medieval old town and a huge market in old airship hangars.
The Gauja valley is Latvia's adventure corner — castles at Sigulda and Turaida, a cable car over the river and forest trails in autumn colour.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Latvia on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
